result.guidanceOfficial: Looking ahead, the second half of 2026 represents a critical period of operational scaling, regulatory alignment, and capital discipline as Faraday Future advances its Five Key Transformations across finance, strategy, business operations, capital structure, and AI systems. With its robotics roadmap formally expanded to the Four-Core Full-Stack AI Ecosystem Strategy, the Company is concentrating its resources on commercial revenue expansion, domestic assembly execution, systematic debt resolution, and establishing a clear trajectory toward sustainable profitability. Financial Outlook Embodied AI (EAI) Robotics serves as Faraday Future’s primary near-term commercial engine. Driven by rising demand across four key commercial sectors, Education, Industrial Applications, Security Inspection, and Existing Core Commercial Markets, the Company is targeting cumulative shipments of more than 2,000 EAI robot units by year-end.
